en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The student will acquire knowledge and skills about the soil environment, the importance of nutrients for cultivated plants and the influence of soil properties on plants, the properties and principles of the correct use of mineral and organic fertilizers and the principles of correct fertilization of woody plants.
